description: This line plot illustrates how the reliability score of three different models—labeled as "3-Model Ensemble" (blue), "2-Model Ensemble" (red), and "GPT-4" (yellow)—varies with increasing cost, measured in units from 0 to 10 on the x-axis. The y-axis represents the "Reliability Score," scaled linearly from 30 to 90. The "GPT-4" line, marked with yellow circles and a solid line, starts at a reliability score of 90 when the cost is 0 and steadily declines to approximately 35 at a cost of 10. The "3-Model Ensemble" line, marked with blue circles and a solid line, begins at a reliability score of approximately 82 at cost 0 and decreases to about 74 at cost 10. The "2-Model Ensemble" line, marked with red circles and a solid line, starts at a reliability score of approximately 85 at cost 0 and declines to about 72 at cost 10. All three lines show a consistent downward trend as cost increases, with GPT-4 experiencing the steepest decline and the 3-Model Ensemble showing the most gradual decline.
